id: "bisect_edge"
title: "Halfedge Edge Bisection (bisect_edge)"
category: graphics
requirement: |-
  ## Module: Halfedge Edge Bisection (bisect_edge)
  Split an edge at its midpoint into two sub-edges without touching adjacent faces. Allocates one new vertex (vm), two new halfedges, and one new edge; rewires all twin/next/vertex/edge/face pointers; propagates interpolated corner and bone-weight data via `interpolate_data`. Foundational building block called directly by `split_edge`.

id: "catmark_subdivide_helper"
title: "Catmull-Clark Topological Subdivision Helper (catmark_subdivide_helper)"
category: graphics
requirement: |-
  ## Module: Catmull-Clark Topological Subdivision Helper (catmark_subdivide_helper)
  Perform the full topological Catmull-Clark subdivision of the entire mesh: split every edge (same concept as `split_edge` applied to all edges), split every non-boundary face into quads around a newly-inserted face-center vertex, then update all vertex positions from pre-computed position maps. Called by `catmark_subdivide()` after it computes the new positions.

  ## Files to modify
  - `src/geometry/halfedge-global.cpp`

  ## Acceptance signals

title: "Halfedge Edge Collapse (collapse_edge)"
category: graphics
requirement: |-
  ## Module: Halfedge Edge Collapse (collapse_edge)
  Merge the two endpoints of an edge into a single midpoint vertex, removing the edge and adjacent faces that would degenerate. Must detect and reject results that would create a non-manifold mesh, handle both triangle and general polygon faces, and propagate interpolated vertex data via `interpolate_data`.

  ## Files to modify
  - `src/geometry/halfedge-local.cpp`

  ## Acceptance signals
  - `std::optional<Halfedge_Mesh::VertexRef> Halfedge_Mesh::collapse_edge(EdgeRef e)`

title: "Halfedge Face Extrusion (extrude_face + extrude_positions)"
category: graphics
requirement: |-
  ## Module: Halfedge Face Extrusion (extrude_face + extrude_positions)
  `extrude_face` creates an inset copy of a face surrounded by new quad side-faces, allocating new vertices, halfedges, edges, and faces. `extrude_positions` then updates those vertex positions by shrinking the inset face toward its centroid and translating it along the face normal by a given distance.

  ## Files to modify
  - `src/geometry/halfedge-local.cpp`

  ## Acceptance signals

title: "Halfedge Edge Flip (flip_edge)"
category: graphics
requirement: |-
  ## Module: Halfedge Edge Flip (flip_edge)
  Rotate a non-boundary edge CCW within its two containing faces, generalising to arbitrary polygon faces. Rewires halfedge connectivity without allocating new mesh elements, then validates the result is manifold.

  ## Files to modify
  - `src/geometry/halfedge-local.cpp`

  ## Acceptance signals
  - `std::optional<Halfedge_Mesh::EdgeRef> Halfedge_Mesh::flip_edge(EdgeRef e)`
=============== global_mesh_utilities.yaml ===============
id: "global_mesh_utilities"
title: "Global Mesh Orientation, Normals, and UV Utilities"
category: graphics
requirement: |-
  ## Module: Global Mesh Orientation, Normals, and UV Utilities
  Three independent global mesh utilities:
  - `flip_orientation` reverses all halfedge loop winding to flip face normals.
  - `set_corner_normals` computes per-corner normals using smoothing groups defined by sharp edges and an angle threshold.
  - `set_corner_uvs_per_face` assigns UV coordinates by projecting each face vertex onto a tangent plane perpendicular to the face normal.

  ## Files to modify
  - `src/geometry/halfedge-global.cpp`

  ## Acceptance signals
  - `void Halfedge_Mesh::flip_orientation()`
  - `void Halfedge_Mesh::set_corner_normals(float threshold)`
  - `void Halfedge_Mesh::set_corner_uvs_per_face()`

  ## Files to modify
  - `src/scene/transform.cpp`

  ## Acceptance signals
  - `Mat4 Transform::local_to_world() const`
  - `Mat4 Transform::world_to_local() const`

  Split an edge and its adjacent non-boundary triangle faces by inserting a midpoint vertex and connecting it to the opposite vertex of each adjacent face, creating two new faces per side.   ## Files to modify

  ## Acceptance signals

# A2: Mesh Editing

In Assignment 2 you will write code to support the interactive editing of meshes in Scotty3D. Scotty3D stores and manipulates meshes using a halfedge mesh structure -- a local connectivity description which allows for fast local topology changes and has clear storage locations for data associated with vertices, edges, faces, and face-corners (/edge-sides).
